description: בדיקות המאגר (`npm test`): **3,278 עברו, 0 נכשלו, 56 דולגו** לאחר הגדרת Chromium המקומי בסביבת הבדיקה

initialAttempt.reason: Playwright expected a missing chromium_headless_shell-1234 executable. The test created its HTTP server before browser launch; after launch failed, the server kept the child alive. The stalled child was stopped after more than 10 minutes.
